people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: When Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.
translations.bsb: When Jesus returned, the crowd welcomed Him, for they had all been waiting for Him.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.
translations.asv: And as Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him; for they were all waiting for him.
